##LIMA and GFCV MERGED, data preparation
LIMA and GFCV counts all samples. 
Here all samples will be processed: first for the GFCV model with a LRT and Wald test and a ~ sex + gfcv + sex:gfcv experimental design; then the LIMA model with a likelihood ratio test (LRT), 
with a ~group experimental design with the 4 levels.
GFCV model aims to compare germ-free vs conventional mice, and observe which molecular
signatures are dependent on the microbiota. LIMA model aims to compare a control group 
(CNT, feed with chow diet), a high fat diet group (HFD, feed with a high sugar high 
animal fat diet) and an intervention group (INT, healthy diet + exerICse). There is a fourth
group that is given a HFD diet but seems to be protected form prediabetes and is excluded
from the LIMA criteria (HFE).

First we load 2 .csv files with counts and metadata information, for each model. 
Then we separate both models to work separately, GFvCV (n=40) and LIMA (n=36)
We convert counts into TPM. To obtain more robust results, we also filter out those genes
that do not appear in at least in 80% of the samples of one or more groups of the
model, cutoff > 0.1 TPM. 

Load the metadata and raw counts for both models
```{r,include=TRUE, results='hide'}
myFactors <- read.csv("MERGED_gfcv&LIMA_metadata.csv",
                         stringsAsFactors = T,
                         colClasses = "factor" ,
                         row.names = 1)

myCounts <- read.csv("MERGED_gfcv&LIMA_raw_counts.csv",
                         stringsAsFactors = F,
                         colClasses = c("character",rep("numeric",74)),
                         row.names = 1)
```

####Model data frames and metadata
Create 2 different data frames for each model, with counts and metadata
```{r}
#counts GFCV
myGFCVcounts <- dplyr::select(myCounts, -contains("X"))

myGFCVcounts <- as.data.frame(t(myGFCVcounts))

#metadata GFCV
myGFCVfactors <- dplyr::slice(myFactors,37:74)


#counts LIMA
myLIMAcounts <- dplyr::select(myCounts, contains("X"))

cln <- colnames(myLIMAcounts)

cln <- gsub("X","",cln)

colnames(myLIMAcounts) <- cln

myLIMAcounts <- as.data.frame(t(myLIMAcounts))

#metadata LIMA
myLIMAfactors <- dplyr::slice(myFactors,1:36)
```

####Length function
Create a function to calculate trasncript length from GTF file (Sonia Tarazona)
```{r}
gtf2length <-  function (mydir, myfile) {
  
  mygtf = read.delim(file.path(mydir, myfile), header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  
  colnames(mygtf) = c("entity", "start", "end", "gene", "transcript")
  
  mygtf = mygtf[which(mygtf[,"entity"] == "exon"),-1]
  
  mylength = abs(mygtf[,"end"]-mygtf[,"start"]) + 1
  
  trans.length = aggregate(mylength, 
                           by = list("gene" = mygtf[,"gene"],
                                     "transcript" = mygtf[,"transcript"]), sum)
  
  gene.length = aggregate(trans.length[,"x"],
                          by = list("gene" = trans.length[,"gene"]), median)
  
  colnames(gene.length)[2] = "length"

  gene.length
  
}
```

####Transcript length calculation
Calculate transcript length from GTF file
```{r}
mydir <- "./"
myfile <- "mmuGTF.txt"

lengthGTF <- data.frame(gtf2length(mydir,myfile))

lengthGTF <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id=lengthGTF$gene,
                        lengthGTF=lengthGTF$length)

lengthGTF$ensembl_gene_id <- stri_sub(lengthGTF$ensembl_gene_id, 1,18)
```

#GFCV model
####TPM calculation
Calculate TPM
```{r}
tpm <- function(counts, lengths) {
  rate <- counts / lengths
  rate / sum(rate) * 1e6
}

myGFCVcounts_t <- as.data.frame(t(myGFCVcounts))

myGFCVcounts_t$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(myGFCVcounts_t)

lengthGTF <- dplyr::inner_join(lengthGTF,
                               myGFCVcounts_t,
                               by="ensembl_gene_id")

lengthGTF <- dplyr::select(lengthGTF,
                           ensembl_gene_id,
                           lengthGTF)

myGFCVcounts_t <- dplyr::select(myGFCVcounts_t,
                                -ensembl_gene_id)

rownames(lengthGTF) <- lengthGTF$ensembl_gene_id

lengthGTF <- dplyr::select(lengthGTF, lengthGTF)

dim(lengthGTF)
dim(myGFCVcounts_t)

gfcvTPM <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id=rownames(myGFCVcounts_t),NA)

for (i in 1:ncol(myGFCVcounts_t)){ 
  sample <- myGFCVcounts_t[,i,drop=T]
  TPM <- tpm(myGFCVcounts_t[,i],lengthGTF)
  gfcvTPM[,i] <- cbind(data.frame(TPM))
  colnames(gfcvTPM) <- colnames(myGFCVcounts_t[,i])
}

colnames(gfcvTPM) <- colnames(myGFCVcounts_t)

rownames(gfcvTPM) <- rownames(myGFCVcounts_t)
```


####Filtering 80% and TPM > 0.1
Filtering out genes with TPM > 0.1, output in counts 
```{r}

# filtering 80% from TPM
dim(gfcvTPM)

gfcvTPMall_t <- as.data.frame(t(gfcvTPM))

dim(gfcvTPMall_t)

myGFCVfactors$groups_m <- factor(myGFCVfactors$groups_m, 
                                 levels = c("CVF","CVM", 
                                            "GFF", "GFM"))

groups <- levels(myGFCVfactors$groups_m)
cutoff <- 0.2
thresholds <- round(table(myGFCVfactors$groups_m) * cutoff)
selected_cols <- lapply(groups, function(i){
  gr <- rownames(myGFCVfactors[myGFCVfactors$groups_m == i,])
  ceros <- gfcvTPMall_t[gr,] == 0
  selc_gr <- which(colSums(ceros) < thresholds[i])
  return(selc_gr)
})
selected_index <- unique(unlist(selected_cols))
myGFCVcountsTPM_80 <- gfcvTPMall_t[,selected_index]

dim(myGFCVcountsTPM_80)
myGFCVcountsTPM_80 <- as.data.frame(t(myGFCVcountsTPM_80))
dim(myGFCVcountsTPM_80)

# Filtering TPM>0.1 after the 80% filter

dim(myGFCVcountsTPM_80)
myGFCVcountsTPM_80 <- myGFCVcountsTPM_80 %>% dplyr::mutate(aver = rowSums(.)/38)

myGFCVcountsTPM_80ord <- dplyr::arrange(myGFCVcountsTPM_80, aver)

dim(myGFCVcountsTPM_80ord)
  
myGFCVcountsTPM_80ord_f <- dplyr::filter(myGFCVcountsTPM_80ord, aver > 0.1)

dim(myGFCVcountsTPM_80ord_f) # same results, the order does not matter

myGFCVcountsTPM_80ord_f <- dplyr::select(myGFCVcountsTPM_80ord_f, -aver)

dim(myGFCVcountsTPM_80ord_f)

```

####80% and 0.1 filtered, raw counts
Only keep genes that appear in 80% of the samples in at least one group. 
```{r}
myGFCVcountsTPM_80_f_id <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id=rownames(myGFCVcountsTPM_80ord_f))


dim(myGFCVcounts_t)
myGFCVcounts_t$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(myGFCVcounts_t)



# keep raw counts for genes with 80% filter
myGFCVcounts80 <- dplyr::inner_join(myGFCVcountsTPM_80_f_id,
                                    myGFCVcounts_t,
                                    by="ensembl_gene_id")

dim(myGFCVcounts80)

rownames(myGFCVcounts80) <- myGFCVcounts80$ensembl_gene_id

myGFCVcounts80 <- dplyr::select(myGFCVcounts80, -ensembl_gene_id)


#Eliminate genes with variance 0
dim(myGFCVcounts80)
gene_var <- data.frame(gene_var=apply(myGFCVcounts80, 1, var))
dim(gene_var)
gene_var_id <- dplyr::filter(gene_var,gene_var>0) # Michael Love against that
dim(gene_var_id)



##################################################
##################################################
##### Matrix to use for DESeq2 and downstream# ###
                dim(myGFCVcounts80)############# #
##################################################
##################################################

write_xlsx(myGFCVcounts80, "myGFCVcounts80.xlsx")

dim(myGFCVcounts80)

myGFCVcounts80_t <- as.data.frame(t(myGFCVcounts80))

dim(myGFCVcounts80_t)


p_rna_raw <-mixOmics::pca(myGFCVcounts80_t, ncomp = 6, center = T, scale = T,
         max.iter = 500, tol = 1e-09, logratio = 'none',   ilr.offset = 0.001,
         V = NULL, multilevel = NULL)


pdf("GFCV_liv_PCAmixomics_raw80_jun2022.pdf")

plotIndiv(p_rna_raw, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$gfcv, legend = T, title= "rna tpm liv by gfcv")

plotIndiv(p_rna_raw, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$groups_m, legend = T, title= "rna tpm liv by group",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_rna_raw, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$sex, legend = T, title= "rna tpm liv by sex",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_rna_raw, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$batch,comp = c(1,2), legend = T, title= "rna tpm liv by batch",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)
plotIndiv(p_rna_raw, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$batch,comp = c(1,3), legend = T, title= "rna tpm liv by batch",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)
plotIndiv(p_rna_raw, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$batch,comp = c(2,3), legend = T, title= "rna tpm liv by batch",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

dev.off()

metapei_id <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id=rownames(myGFCVcounts80))


save(metapei_id, file="GFCV_metaepi1_20k_ensembl_gene_id_80filter.Rdata")

write_xlsx(metapei_id, "GFCV_metaepi1_20k_ensembl_gene_id_80filter.xlsx")
write.csv(myGFCVcountsTPM_80, file = "GFCV_transcriptomics_filtered.csv", 
          row.names = TRUE)
```

####t-SNE using TPM
Visualization using Rtsne
  https://support.bioconductor.org/p/97594/
```{r}
#Rtsne
dim(myGFCVcounts80_t)

set.seed(42) # Sets seed for reproducibility
tsne_out <- Rtsne(as.matrix(myGFCVcounts80_t),perplexity = 12,) # Run TSNE
plot(tsne_out$Y,col=myGFCVfactors$groups_m,asp=1 ) # Plot the result
plot(tsne_out$Y,col=myGFCVfactors$gfcv,asp=1 ) # Plot the result
plot(tsne_out$Y,col=myGFCVfactors$batch,asp=1 ) # Plot the result


toplot <- as.data.frame(tsne_out$Y)

rownames(toplot) <- myGFCVfactors$samplename

pdf("GFCV_liv_tSNE_rna_counts80_jun2022.pdf")

ggplot(toplot, aes(x = V1, y = V2,
                   shape=myGFCVfactors$groups_m,
                   color=myGFCVfactors$groups_m,
                   group=myGFCVfactors$groups_m))+ 
  geom_point() +
  ggtitle("GFCV t-SNE of raw counts by type gfcv\nTPM>0.1 & filter 80%") +
  xlab("t-SNE_1") + ylab("t-SNE_2") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("springgreen4","springgreen4","orangered2", "orangered2")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(2,1,2,1))  
dev.off()

ggplot(toplot, aes(x = V1, y = V2,
                   shape=myGFCVfactors$batch,
                   color=myGFCVfactors$batch,
                   group=myGFCVfactors$batch))+ 
  geom_point() +
  ggtitle("GFCV t-SNE of raw counts by batch\nTPM>0.1 & filter 80%") +
  xlab("t-SNE_1") + ylab("t-SNE_2") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("green", "red"))

```

####DESeq2 and VST transformation
```{r}
myGFCVfactors$sex_m <- factor(myGFCVfactors$sex_m , ordered = F)

myGFCVfactors_gs <- dplyr::select(myGFCVfactors, gfcv, sex_m)



ddsGFCV80 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = myGFCVcounts80,
                                      colData = myGFCVfactors_gs,
                                      design= ~ gfcv + sex_m + gfcv:sex_m)


ddsGFCV80 <- DESeq(ddsGFCV80, test = "Wald")


vsdGFCV80 <- vst(ddsGFCV80, blind = FALSE)

#plotPCA with vst() transformed data

pdf("GFCV_liv_PCAdeseq2_vst_jun2022.pdf")
plotPCA(vsdGFCV80, intgroup=c("gfcv", "sex_m"))
dev.off()


# Extract transformed matrix

vsdGFCV80_mat <- assay(vsdGFCV80)

dim(vsdGFCV80_mat)

class(vsdGFCV80_mat)

vsdGFCV80_df <- as.data.frame(vsdGFCV80_mat)

# filter vst transformed data var=0
dim(vsdGFCV80_mat)
gene_vst_var <- data.frame(gene_var=apply(vsdGFCV80_mat, 1, var))
dim(gene_vst_var)
gene_var_vst_id <- dplyr::filter(gene_vst_var,gene_var>0)
dim(gene_var_vst_id)

df <- bind_rows(
  as_tibble(assay(vsdGFCV80)[, 1:2]) %>% mutate(transformation = "vst"))
  
colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("x", "y")  


ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) + geom_hex(bins = 80) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0,25), ylim =  c(0,25))
dim(df)

```

####t-SNE using VST
Visualization using Rtsne
  https://support.bioconductor.org/p/97594/
```{r}
#Rtsne 80% filter

dim(vsdGFCV80_mat)

vsdGFCV80_mat_t <- as.data.frame(t(vsdGFCV80_mat))

set.seed(42) # Sets seed for reproducibility
tsne_out <- Rtsne(as.matrix(vsdGFCV80_mat_t),perplexity = 12) # Run TSNE

pdf("GFCV_liv_tSNE_vst_jun2022.pdf")
plot(tsne_out$Y,col=myGFCVfactors$sex_m,asp=1, main= "t-sne results 80% by sex" ) # Plot the result

plot(tsne_out$Y,col=myGFCVfactors$gfcv,asp=1, main= "t-sne results 80% by group" ) # Plot the result
plot(tsne_out$Y,col=myGFCVfactors$groups_m,asp=1, main= "t-sne results 80% by group and sex" )

plot(tsne_out$Y,col=myGFCVfactors$batch,asp=1, main= "t-sne results 80% by collection batch" )

toplot <- as.data.frame(tsne_out$Y)

rownames(toplot) <- myGFCVfactors$samplename

ggplot(toplot, aes(x = V1, y = V2,
                   shape=myGFCVfactors$groups_m,
                   color=myGFCVfactors$groups_m,
                   group=myGFCVfactors$groups_m))+ 
  geom_point() +
  ggtitle("GFCV t-SNE representation \n TPM > 0.1 \n80% filtering\n VST scaled") +
```

##ComBat batch correction
There is a mild batch effect that we already saw in other omics and we opted to correct this batch effect with the same algorithm (ComBat)
```{r}
# Combat on 80% and 0.1 filtered data
dim(myGFCVcounts80)
class(myGFCVcounts80)

myGFCVcounts80_m <- as.matrix(myGFCVcounts80)

    
myGFCVcounts80_CB <-  ComBat(myGFCVcounts80_m, myGFCVfactors$batch)


sum(table(myGFCVcounts80_CB[myGFCVcounts80_CB<0]))


myGFCVcounts80_CB[myGFCVcounts80_CB<0] <- 0


sum(table(myGFCVcounts80_CB[myGFCVcounts80_CB<0]))


myGFCVcounts80_CB <- as.data.frame(round(myGFCVcounts80_CB, digits = 0))


dim(myGFCVcounts80_CB)

pdf("GFCV_liv_boxplot_80&01_raw&vst_jun2022.pdf")
boxplot(log10(myGFCVcounts80_CB), las=2, main= "80 and 01 raw combat corrected")
boxplot(log10(myGFCVcounts80), las=2, main= "80 and 01 raw not combat corrected")


boxplot(vsdGFCV80_mat, las=2, main= "80 and 01 vst not combat corrected")
dev.off()

myGFCVcounts80_CB <- as.data.frame(t(myGFCVcounts80_CB))


dim(myGFCVcounts80_CB)
dim(myGFCVcounts80_t)


p_rnaCB <-mixOmics::pca(myGFCVcounts80_CB, ncomp = 6, center = T, scale = T,
         max.iter = 500, tol = 1e-09, logratio = 'none',   ilr.offset = 0.001,
         V = NULL, multilevel = NULL)

p_rna <-mixOmics::pca(myGFCVcounts80_t, ncomp = 6, center = T, scale = T,
         max.iter = 500, tol = 1e-09, logratio = 'none',   ilr.offset = 0.001,
         V = NULL, multilevel = NULL)


pdf("GFCV_liv_PCAmixom_rna_CB&noCB_feb2022_jun2022.pdf")

plotIndiv(p_rnaCB, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$gfcv, legend = T, title= "rna liv CB by gfcv")

plotIndiv(p_rna, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$gfcv, legend = T, title= "rna liv not CB by gfcv")


plotIndiv(p_rnaCB, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$groups_m, legend = T, title= "rna liv CB by group")

plotIndiv(p_rna, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$groups_m, legend = T, title= "rna liv not CB by group")


plotIndiv(p_rnaCB, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$sex, legend = T, title= "rna liv CB by sex",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_rna, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$sex, legend = T, title= "rna liv not CB by sex",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)


plotIndiv(p_rnaCB, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$batch, legend = T,comp = c(1,2), title= "rna liv CB by batch",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_rna, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$batch, legend = T,comp = c(1,2), title= "rna liv not CB by batch",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)


plotIndiv(p_rnaCB, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$batch, legend = T,comp = c(1,3), title= "rna liv CB by batch",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_rna, ind.names = T, group = myGFCVfactors$batch, legend = T,comp = c(1,3), title= "rna liv not CB by batch",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)


dev.off()

#Eliminate genes with variance 0
myGFCVcounts80_CB <- as.data.frame(t(myGFCVcounts80_CB))

gene_var <- data.frame(gene_var=apply(myGFCVcounts80_CB, 1, var))
dim(gene_var)
gene_var_id <- dplyr::filter(gene_var,gene_var>0) # Michael Love against eliminating low variance genes for DESeq2
dim(gene_var_id)
```

#TMM & VST normalization
Using myGFCVcounts80_CB (no TPM filtering) corrected data
```{r}

# TMM transformation

#myGFCVcounts80_CB

dim(myGFCVcounts80)
dim(myGFCVfactors)

myGFCVfactors_tmm <- data.frame(sample=rownames(myGFCVfactors),
                                group=stri_sub(rownames(myGFCVfactors),1,2),
                                gfcv=stri_sub(rownames(myGFCVfactors),1,1),
                                sex=stri_sub(rownames(myGFCVfactors),2,2),
                                batch=stri_sub(rownames(myGFCVfactors),4,4),
                                lib.size=colSums(myGFCVcounts80_CB))

dim(myGFCVfactors_tmm)



#DGEList object 80%filter
y <- DGEList(counts=myGFCVcounts80,
             samples = myGFCVfactors_tmm)

y <- calcNormFactors(y,method = "TMM",lib.size=y$samples$lib.size)


cpms <- cpm(y, log=FALSE)

logcpms <- cpm(y, log=TRUE)

#MDS plot
pdf("GFCV_plotMDS_cpms_edgeR_jun2022.pdf")
plotMDS(cpms, labels=y$samples$sample,main="CPMs")

plotMDS(logcpms, labels=y$samples$sample,main="logCPMs")
dev.off()



#Eliminate genes with variance 0
gene_var <- data.frame(gene_var=apply(cpms, 1, var))
dim(gene_var)
gene_var_id <- dplyr::filter(gene_var,gene_var>0) # Michael Love against that for input to DESeq2
dim(gene_var_id)


#PCA tmm counts

         V = NULL, multilevel = NULL)

# VST transformation for MOFA (leght size + vst)
```

#GFCV DESeq2
Run DESeq with LRT
####DESeq LRT
```{r}
# LRT only 80% filtering
dim(myGFCVcounts80)
dim(myGFCVfactors)

test <- myGFCVcounts80

test <- test %>% dplyr::mutate(row_sum = rowSums(.))

ddsGFCV80 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = myGFCVcounts80,
                                      colData = myGFCVfactors,
                                      design= ~ gfcv + sex_m + gfcv:sex_m)

#set the reference group
ddsGFCV80$gfcv <- relevel(ddsGFCV80$gfcv, ref = "C")

ddsGFCV80$sex_m <- relevel(ddsGFCV80$sex_m, ref = "M")

#LRT
ddsGFCV80 <- DESeq(ddsGFCV80, test = "LRT", reduced = ~1)

resultsNames(ddsGFCV80)

resGFCV80LRT <- results(ddsGFCV80, filterFun = ihw)


summary(resGFCV80LRT)

dim(resGFCV80LRTsig)

dim(resGFCV80LRTsig)
```

####20k DESeq res Wald pairwise (int, GFvCV, FvM, GFFvGFM, CVFvCVM, GFFvCVF, GFMvCVM)
```{r}
#gfcv and sex_m DESeq2 design for int,GFvCV, FvM
#int all 20k
ddsGFCV80w_int <- DESeq(ddsGFCV80)

resddsGFCV80w20k_int <- results(ddsGFCV80w_int,
                         filterFun = ihw)

resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df <- as.data.frame(resddsGFCV80w20k_int)

resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df)

ensembl_gene_id_int_all <- resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df$ensembl_gene_id

# mouse <-  useEnsembl("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl",  mirror = "asia")

myBiomart_int_all <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id",
                                          "gene_biotype",
                                          "description",
                                          "entrezgene_accession",
                                          "entrezgene_id"),
                         filters = c("ensembl_gene_id"),
                         values= c(ensembl_gene_id_int_all),
                         mart = mouse)


myBiomart_int_all$entrezgene_accession[myBiomart_int_all$entrezgene_accession==""]<-NA

setDT(myBiomart_int_all)

myBiomart_int_all[is.na(entrezgene_accession) , 
               entrezgene_accession := ensembl_gene_id ]


dim(myBiomart_int_all)

resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df <- resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df[order(resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df$padj),]

resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df <- dplyr::inner_join(resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df,
                                              myBiomart_int_all,
                                              by = "ensembl_gene_id")

dim(resddsGFCV80w20k_int_all_df)



# int Sig 20k
```

####nov2022 CVM
```{r}

normcounts_ddsGFCV80 <- counts(ddsGFCV80, normalized=TRUE)

normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df <- as.data.frame(normcounts_ddsGFCV80)

normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df)

ensembl_gene_id_sig <- data.frame(
  ensembl_gene_id=resGFCV80LRTsig$ensembl_gene_id,
  entrezgene_accession=resGFCV80LRTsig$entrezgene_accession)


normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig <- dplyr::inner_join(normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df,
                                                 ensembl_gene_id_sig,
                                                 by="ensembl_gene_id")

dim(normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig)

normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig <- dplyr::select(
  normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig, -entrezgene_accession)

normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig <- dplyr::distinct(normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig)

dim(normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig)

rownames(normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig) <- normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig$ensembl_gene_id

normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig <- dplyr::select(normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig,-ensembl_gene_id)



CVF <- normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig%>%dplyr::select(contains("CF"))%>%rowMeans()%>% as.data.frame()%>% dplyr::rename(., CVFm=.)

CVF$CVFsd <- normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig%>%dplyr::select(contains("CF"))%>%apply(.,1,sd)%>% as.data.frame()


CVM <- normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig%>%dplyr::select(contains("CM"))%>%rowMeans()%>% as.data.frame()%>% dplyr::rename(., CVMm=.)

CVM$CVMsd <- normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig%>%dplyr::select(contains("CM"))%>%apply(.,1,sd)%>% as.data.frame()


GFF <- normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig%>%dplyr::select(contains("GF"))%>%rowMeans()%>% as.data.frame()%>% dplyr::rename(., GFFm=.)
GFF$GFFsd <- normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig%>%dplyr::select(contains("GF"))%>%apply(.,1,sd)%>% as.data.frame()


GFM <- normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig%>%dplyr::select(contains("GM"))%>%rowMeans()%>% as.data.frame()%>% dplyr::rename(., GFMm=.)
GFM$GFMsd <- normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig%>%dplyr::select(contains("GM"))%>%apply(.,1,sd)%>% as.data.frame()


normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig <- dplyr::bind_cols(normcounts_ddsGFCV80_df_sig,CVF,CVM,GFF,GFM)

normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig <- dplyr::select(
  normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig, 
  CVFm,CVFsd,CVMm,CVMsd,
  GFFm,GFFsd,GFMm,GFMsd
)

normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(
  normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig)

normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig <- dplyr::inner_join(
  normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig,resGFCV80LRTsig, by="ensembl_gene_id")

normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig <- dplyr::arrange(normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig, padj)


# function to selest CVM with higher or lower normalized counts compared to the other groups

plotCounts(ddsGFCV80, gene="ENSMUSG00000015451", intgroup="groups_m") #C4A


normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig$max_cat <-
  normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig %>% 
  dplyr::select(contains(c("CVFm","CVMm","GFFm","GFMm"))) %>%
  apply(.,1,function(row) colnames(.)[which.max(row)])
  
normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig$min_cat <-
  normcounts_mean_ddsGFCV80_df_sig %>%
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(avr_L2FC_onlyCVM, "GFCV_CVM_commALLcomp_DEGs_onlydiffCVM_24nov2022.xlsx")




avr_L2FC_onlyCVM <- dplyr::select(avr_L2FC_onlyCVM, -entrezgene_accession, -entrezgene_id)

avr_L2FC_onlyCVM <- dplyr::distinct(avr_L2FC_onlyCVM)


genes_all_L2FC_onlyCVM <- avr_L2FC_onlyCVM$avrFC

names(genes_all_L2FC_onlyCVM) <- avr_L2FC_onlyCVM$ensembl_gene_id

genes_all_L2FC_onlyCVM <- sort(genes_all_L2FC_onlyCVM,decreasing = T)



#all GO
genes_all_L2FC_onlyCVM_gsea_allGO <- gseGO(geneList     = genes_all_L2FC_onlyCVM,
                           OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                           ont          = "all",
                           minGSSize    = 3,
                           maxGSSize    = 500,
                           pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
                           verbose      = FALSE, 
                           keyType      = 'ENSEMBL',
                           nPermSimple = 1000000, eps = 0)

genes_all_L2FC_onlyCVM_gsea_allGO_df <- as.data.frame(genes_all_L2FC_onlyCVM_gsea_allGO)


length(genes_all_L2FC_onlyCVM) # gene universe

#GO gene set enrichment analisis Sig genes netwok plot
```

##topGO GFCV
####topGO int sex&group unique 
```{r}


topGO_int_sexgroup <- all_genesID_int_sexgroup_20k$padj #common_genesID_sexgroup

names(topGO_int_sexgroup) <- all_genesID_int_sexgroup_20k$ensembl_gene_id

head(topGO_int_sexgroup)

tail(topGO_int_sexgroup)

selection <- function(allScore){ return(allScore < 0.1)}
allGO2genes <- annFUN.org(whichOnto="BP", feasibleGenes=NULL, mapping="org.Mm.eg.db", ID="ensembl")

GOdata_int_sexgroup <- new("topGOdata",
                           ontology="BP",
                           allGenes=topGO_int_sexgroup,
                           annot=annFUN.GO2genes,
                           GO2genes=allGO2genes,
                           geneSel=selection,
                           nodeSize=1,
                           description="DE genes int sex&group in GO BP")

results.stat <- runTest(GOdata_int_sexgroup, algorithm="weight01", statistic="ks") # algorithm: "classic" "elim"  "weight01"/ stat:"fisher" "ks" "t"

goEnrichment <- GenTable(GOdata_int_sexgroup, KS=results.stat, orderBy="KS", topNodes=581)
goEnrichment$KS <- gsub("< 1e-30","1e-30",goEnrichment$KS)
goEnrichment$KS
goEnrichment$KS <- as.numeric(goEnrichment$KS)
goEnrichment <- goEnrichment[goEnrichment$KS<0.05,]
goEnrichment <- goEnrichment[,c("GO.ID","Term","KS")]
goEnrichment$Term <- gsub(" [a-z]*\\.\\.\\.$", "", goEnrichment$Term)
goEnrichment$Term <- gsub("\\.\\.\\.$", "", goEnrichment$Term)
goEnrichment$Term <- paste(goEnrichment$GO.ID, goEnrichment$Term, sep=", ")
goEnrichment$Term <- factor(goEnrichment$Term, levels=rev(goEnrichment$Term))
length(goEnrichment$KS)

write_xlsx(goEnrichment, file = "GFCV_GO_int_sexgroup.xlsx")

goEnrichment$KS <- as.numeric(goEnrichment$KS)

plotbar <- ggplot(goEnrichment, aes(x=Term, y=-log10(KS))) +
  stat_summary(geom = "bar", fun = mean, position = "dodge") +
  xlab("Biological process") +
  ylab("Enrichment") +
  ggtitle("GOe unique genes DE int sex&group, (alg=weight01, stat=ks<0.05)") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = round(seq(0, max(-log10(goEnrichment$KS)), by = 2), 1)) +
  theme_bw(base_size=18) +
  theme(
    legend.position='none',
    legend.background=element_rect(),
    plot.title=element_text(angle=0, size=16, face="bold", vjust=1, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x=element_text(angle=0, size=10, face="bold", hjust=1.10),
    axis.text.y=element_text(angle=0, size=10, face="bold", vjust=0.5),
    axis.title=element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
    legend.key=element_blank(),     #removes the border
    legend.key.size=unit(1, "cm"),      #Sets overall area/size of the legend
    legend.text=element_text(size=10),  #Text size
    title=element_text(size=10)) +
  guides(colour=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=2.5))) +
  coord_flip()

ggsave( "topGO_unique_genes_int_sexgroup_weight01KS_005_jun2022.pdf", plotbar, width = 7, height = 7, limitsize = FALSE)

genesInTerm_int_unique <-genesInTerm(GOdata_int_sexgroup)
```

#MOFA RNAvst sig LRT all groupssep2022
```{r}
setwd ("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/RNAseq/AA_MOFA_sep2022/")

liv_rna_vst <- read.csv(file ="~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/RNAseq/GFCV_liv_rna_4_stats_vst.csv", 
                    header = T, sep = ",",stringsAsFactors = F)

liv_rna_vst <- dplyr::distinct(liv_rna_vst)
dim(liv_rna_vst)

rna_ID_sig <- read.csv(file ="~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/RNAseq/GFCV_DEg_LRT_general_Sig_20k_jun2022.csv",
                       header = T, sep = ",",stringsAsFactors = F)

dim(rna_ID_sig)

rna_ID_sig <- dplyr::select(rna_ID_sig, ensembl_gene_id)

rna_ID_sig <- dplyr::distinct(rna_ID_sig)

dim(rna_ID_sig)

colnames(rna_ID_sig) <- "X"

liv_rna_vst_sig <- dplyr::inner_join(rna_ID_sig,liv_rna_vst, by= "X")
dim(liv_rna_vst_sig)

rownames(liv_rna_vst_sig) <- liv_rna_vst_sig$X

liv_rna_vst_sig <- liv_rna_vst_sig %>% dplyr::select(-X)

# features in cols
liv_rna_vst_sig_t <- liv_rna_vst_sig %>% t()
dim(liv_rna_vst_sig_t)


liv_rna_cond <- dplyr::select(liv_rna_vst, -X)

liv_rna_cond <- as.data.frame(t(liv_rna_cond))

liv_rna_cond <- data.frame(X=rownames(liv_rna_cond),
                           type_gfcv=stri_sub(rownames(liv_rna_cond),1,2),
                           group=stri_sub(rownames(liv_rna_cond),1,1),
                           sex=stri_sub(rownames(liv_rna_cond),2,2),
                           batch=stri_sub(rownames(liv_rna_cond),4,4))

dim(liv_rna_cond)


# add metadata columns

liv_rna_vst_sig_t <- dplyr::bind_cols(liv_rna_cond,liv_rna_vst_sig_t)
dim(liv_rna_vst_sig_t)

# melt df for MOFA
liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m <- reshape2::melt(liv_rna_vst_sig_t, id.vars = c("X", "type_gfcv",
                                        "group","sex","batch"),
                   variable.name = "feature",
                   value.name = "value")

liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m <- dplyr::select(liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m, -group, -sex, -batch)

colnames(liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m) <- c("sample", "group", "feature" , "value")

liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m$view <- "liv_rna"

liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m <- dplyr::relocate(liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m, feature, .before = "group" )
liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m <- dplyr::relocate(liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m, view, .before = "group" )
# liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m <- dplyr::filter(liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m, !is.na(value))
liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m_mg <- liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m   #multi-group framework option
liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m <- dplyr::select(liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m, -group)

head(liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m)
dim(liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m)


# preparing MOFA parameters

MOFAobject_rna_v <- liv_rna_vst_sig_t_m



dim(MOFAobject_rna_v)


MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa <- create_mofa_from_df(MOFAobject_rna_v)


print(MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa)



#data options
data_opts_rna <- get_default_data_options(MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa)
head(data_opts_rna)

data_opts_rna$scale_views <- T
data_opts_rna$scale_groups <- F

head(data_opts_rna)


#model options
model_opts_rna <- get_default_model_options(MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa)
head(model_opts_rna)

model_opts_rna$num_factors <- 3
head(model_opts_rna)


#training options
train_opts_rna <- get_default_training_options(MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa)
head(train_opts_rna)

train_opts_rna$convergence_mode <- "slow"
train_opts_rna$drop_factor_threshold <- -1
train_opts_rna$maxiter <- 10000


#prepare MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa
MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa <- prepare_mofa(
  object = MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa,
  data_options = data_opts_rna,
  model_options = model_opts_rna,
  training_options = train_opts_rna
)



# Train MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa 
outfile = file.path(getwd(),"model_rna_v.hdf5")
MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa_trained <- run_mofa(MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa, outfile, use_basilisk = TRUE)

plot_factor_cor(MOFAobject_rna_v_mofa_trained)


# Adding metadata to the model

colnames(liv_rna_cond) <- c("sample","type_gfcv", 
                              "gfcv", "sex", "batch")

type_gfcv.colors <- c("#EB6429FF","#30B57CFF",
                      "#FCAC11FF","#84D44BFF")
gfcv.colors <- c("#34618DFF","#FDE725FF")
sex.colors <- c("#B73557FF","#218E8DFF")
batch.colors <- c("orange","grey")

views_rna <- "liv_rna"


mofa_group <- c("type_gfcv","gfcv","sex","batch")
```

#Wald CVMvnCM and MOFA RNAvst sig Wald CVMvnCM sep2022
```{r}
dim(myGFCVcounts80)

## CM_group
myGFCVfactors_CM$CM_group <- myGFCVfactors_CM$groups_m

CVM <- myGFCVfactors_CM$CM_group

CVM <- gsub("CVF","nCM", CVM)
CVM <- gsub("GFF","nCM", CVM)
CVM <- gsub("GFM","nCM", CVM)

myGFCVfactors_CM$CM_group <- CVM

ddsGFCV80_CM <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = myGFCVcounts80,
                                       colData = myGFCVfactors_CM,
                                       design= ~ CM_group)


ddsGFCV80_CM <- DESeq(ddsGFCV80_CM, test = "LRT", reduced = ~1)


resGFCV80LRT_CM <- results(ddsGFCV80_CM, filterFun = ihw)

resGFCV80LRT_CM_df <- as.data.frame(resGFCV80LRT_CM)

resGFCV80LRT_CM_df <- dplyr::arrange(resGFCV80LRT_CM_df, padj)


dim(myBiomart_GFvCV_all)


ddsGFCV80_CM_wald <- DESeq(ddsGFCV80_CM)

resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM <- results(ddsGFCV80_CM_wald,
                                  filterFun = ihw,
                                  test= "Wald",
                                  contrast = c("CM_group",
                                               "CVM","nCM"))

resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df <- as.data.frame(resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM)

resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df <- dplyr::arrange(
  resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df, padj
)

resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df)

resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df <- dplyr::inner_join(
  resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df,myBiomart_GFvCV_all,
  by="ensembl_gene_id") 

resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df_sig <- dplyr::filter(
  resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df, padj<0.1
)

dim(resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df_sig)
View(resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df_sig)
```

```{r}
dim(mito_resGFCV80LRTsig)

dim(mito_resGFCV80LRTsig_protcod)

# mito sig DE genes counts (20k)

mito_resGFCV80LRTsig_vst_counts <- dplyr::inner_join(myGFCVcounts80_vst, mito_resGFCV80LRTsig_ensembl_gene_id,
                                                     by="ensembl_gene_id")

# PCAnoiseq on mito genes
mito_myGFCVcounts80_vst <- dplyr::select(mito_myGFCVcounts80_vst,
                                         -ensembl_gene_id)

mito_resGFCV80LRTsig_vst_counts <-  dplyr::select(mito_resGFCV80LRTsig_vst_counts,
                                         -ensembl_gene_id)

mito_resGFCV80LRTsig_vst_noiseq <-  NOISeq::readData(data = mito_resGFCV80LRTsig_vst_counts, factors = myGFCVfactors)

mito_myGFCVcounts80_vst_noiseq <- NOISeq::readData(data = mito_myGFCVcounts80_vst, factors = myGFCVfactors)

mito_vst80PCAnoiseq <-  dat(mito_myGFCVcounts80_vst_noiseq,
                       type = "PCA",
                       logtransf = F,
                       norm = T)

mito_sig_vst80PCAnoiseq <-  dat(mito_resGFCV80LRTsig_vst_noiseq,
                       type = "PCA",
                       logtransf = F,
                       norm = T)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 

pdf("GFCV_liv_mitoGenes_PCAnoiseq_vst80_jun2022.pdf")

explo.plot(mito_vst80PCAnoiseq, factor = "groups_m")
explo.plot(mito_sig_vst80PCAnoiseq, factor = "groups_m")


explo.plot(mito_vst80PCAnoiseq, factor = "sex_m")
explo.plot(mito_sig_vst80PCAnoiseq, factor = "sex_m")

explo.plot(mito_vst80PCAnoiseq, factor = "batch")
explo.plot(mito_sig_vst80PCAnoiseq, factor = "batch")

dev.off()

# DESeq2 with 2 group, CM and no-CM
dim(myGFCVfactors)


myGFCVfactors_CM <- myGFCVfactors

## CM_group
myGFCVfactors_CM$CM_group <- myGFCVfactors_CM$groups_m

CVM <- myGFCVfactors_CM$CM_group

CVM <- gsub("CVF","nCM", CVM)
CVM <- gsub("GFF","nCM", CVM)
CVM <- gsub("GFM","nCM", CVM)

myGFCVfactors_CM$CM_group <- CVM

ddsGFCV80_CM <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = myGFCVcounts80,
                                       colData = myGFCVfactors_CM,
                                       design= ~ CM_group)


ddsGFCV80_CM <- DESeq(ddsGFCV80_CM, test = "LRT", reduced = ~1)


resGFCV80LRT_CM <- results(ddsGFCV80_CM, filterFun = ihw)

resGFCV80LRT_CM_df <- as.data.frame(resGFCV80LRT_CM)

resGFCV80LRT_CM_df <- dplyr::arrange(resGFCV80LRT_CM_df, padj)


dim(myBiomart_GFvCV_all)


ddsGFCV80_CM_wald <- DESeq(ddsGFCV80_CM)

resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM <- results(ddsGFCV80_CM_wald,
                                  filterFun = ihw,
                                  test= "Wald",
                                  contrast = c("CM_group",
                                               "CVM","nCM"))

resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM_df <- as.data.frame(resddsGFCV80w20k_CVMvnCM)
```

```{r}
ddsGCFM_overlap <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=sex_micro_overlap_counts,
                                       colData = myGFCVfactors,
                                       design= ~ groups_m)

# GFMvCVM
resddsGCFM_overlap_GFMvCVM <- results(ddsGCFM_overlap,
                                    filterFun = ihw,
                                    contrast = c("groups_m","GFM","CVM"))

resddsGCFM_overlap_GFMvCVM_df <- as.data.frame(resddsGCFM_overlap_GFMvCVM)


resddsGCFM_overlap_GFMvCVM_df$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(resddsGCFM_overlap_GFMvCVM_df)

resddsGCFM_overlap_GFMvCVM_df_sig <- dplyr::filter(resddsGCFM_overlap_GFMvCVM_df, padj<0.1)

dim(resddsGCFM_overlap_GFMvCVM_df_sig)



# GFMvGFF

                                    filterFun = ihw,
```

```{r}
# MOFArna pos weighs gene
length(CVM_pos00_gene_list)

CVM_pos00_gene_list_ensembl_gene_id <- names(CVM_pos00_gene_list)

CVM_pos00_gene_list_df <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id=names(CVM_pos00_gene_list),
                                     log2FC=CVM_pos00_gene_list)
dim(CVM_pos00_gene_list_df)

CVM_pos00_gene_list_df <- dplyr::distinct(CVM_pos00_gene_list_df)
dim(CVM_pos00_gene_list_df)

CVM_pos00_gene_list_ensembl_gene_id <- CVM_pos00_gene_list_df$ensembl_gene_id


CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id",
                                       "entrezgene_id",
                                       "entrezgene_accession"),
                     filters = c("ensembl_gene_id"),
                     values= CVM_pos00_gene_list_ensembl_gene_id,
                     mart = mouse)

dim(CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart)

CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart <- dplyr::inner_join(
  CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart,
  CVM_pos00_gene_list_df, by="ensembl_gene_id")

CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart <- dplyr::filter(CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart, !entrezgene_id=="NA")
dim(CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart)

CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart <- dplyr::distinct(CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart)
dim(CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart)

CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart$dup <- duplicated(lapply(CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart$entrezgene_id, unique))
CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart <- dplyr::filter(CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart, dup=="FALSE")
dim(CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart)


CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id <- CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart$log2FC

names(CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id) <- CVM_pos00_gene_list_biomart$entrezgene_id

CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id <- sort(CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id, decreasing = T)

CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id_FC <- CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id[abs(CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id) > 1]

length(CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id_FC)

CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id_FC <- sort(CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id_FC, decreasing = T)


CVM_pos00_gene_gsea_pathw <-  gsePathway(
  CVM_pos00_gene_list_entrezgene_id,
  organism = "mouse",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
```

```{r}
setwd ("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/RNAseq/comp_general_int_LRT_20k/LRT_SigG_ORA_KEGG_20k/")
####KEGG analysis####
###input df A x ORA: DE Sig genes (padj, LFC, ID) from results(DESeq2) padj<0.1
kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id=resGFCV80LRT@rownames)

kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k$padj <- resGFCV80LRT@listData[["padj"]]

kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k$log2FoldChange <- resGFCV80LRT@listData[["log2FoldChange"]]

class(kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k)

kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k$padj <- as.numeric(kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k$padj)

kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k$log2FoldChange <- as.numeric(kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k$log2FoldChange)


ensembl_id_gen_LRT_20k <- kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k$ensembl_gene_id

table(ensembl_id_gen_LRT_20k==kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k$ensembl_gene_id)

#add description and entrezgene_id and entrezgene_accession
LRT_kg_bioMart_20k <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id",
                                       "entrezgene_id",
                                       "entrezgene_accession"),
                     filters = c("ensembl_gene_id"),
                     values= c(ensembl_id_gen_LRT_20k),
                     mart = mouse)
dim(LRT_kg_bioMart_20k)
length(ensembl_id_gen_LRT_20k)
colnames(LRT_kg_bioMart_20k)
colnames(kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k)

kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k <- dplyr::inner_join(kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k, LRT_kg_bioMart_20k, by = "ensembl_gene_id")
kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k <- dplyr::arrange(kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k,desc(abs(kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k$log2FoldChange)))
dim(kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k)

#filter padj < 0.1 and LFC > 0.1
sigGenes_LRT_20k <- kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k %>% #vector of gene names
                drop_na(entrezgene_id, padj) %>% 
                filter(padj < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.1) %>% 
                pull(entrezgene_id)
sigLFC_LRT_20k <- kgg_gfcv_LRT_20k %>%filter(padj < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.1) 
sigLFC_LRT_20k <- sigLFC_LRT_20k %>%drop_na(entrezgene_id) # named numeric vector


#pathview
LFC_LRT_20k <- sigLFC_LRT_20k$log2FoldChange
names(LFC_LRT_20k) <- sigLFC_LRT_20k$entrezgene_id
pathview(gene.data = LFC_LRT_20k, 
         pathway.id = "mmu00270", 
         species = "mmu", 
         limit = list(gene=2, cpd=1))

  mylist_temp <- list(str_split(entrezgene_id_list_LRT[i, "entrezgene_id"], 
                 pattern = "/",simplify = T))
  mylist[[length(mylist) + 1]] <- mylist_temp
}
```

```{r}
KGterm_all_LRT_df$KGdescription <- df_results_kkterms_LRT$Description
```

```{r}
         species = "mmu", 
         limit = list(gene=2, cpd=1))

#filter padj < 0.1 and LFC > 0.1
sigLFC_uGFvCV <- go_gfcv_uGFvCV %>%filter(padj < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.1) 
sigLFC_uGFvCV <- go_gfcv_uGFvCV %>%drop_na(ensembl_gene_id) 
namesV <- sigLFC_uGFvCV$ensembl_gene_id
sigLFC_uGFvCV <- sigLFC_uGFvCV$log2FoldChange# named numeric vector
names(sigLFC_uGFvCV) <- namesV

##GO gene set enrichment analisis (GSEA) using sigLFC_uGFvCV named vector
sigLFC_uGFvCV <- sort(sigLFC_uGFvCV, decreasing = T)

go_uGFvCV_gsea <- gseGO(geneList     = sigLFC_uGFvCV,
                       OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                     ont          = "ALL",
                     minGSSize    = 10,
                     maxGSSize    = 500,
                     pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
                     verbose      = FALSE, 
                     keyType      = 'ENSEMBL',
                     nPermSimple = 10000)


dim(go_uGFvCV_gsea)
# View(go_uGFvCV_gsea)

go_uGFvCV_gsea <- dplyr::filter(go_uGFvCV_gsea, p.adjust<=0.1)
go_uGFvCV_gsea <- dplyr::arrange(go_uGFvCV_gsea, p.adjust)
dim(go_uGFvCV_gsea)


length(sigLFC_uGFvCV) # gene universe

#GO gene set enrichment analisis Sig genes netwok plot
library("ggnewscale")
edox <- setReadable(go_uGFvCV_gsea, "org.Mm.eg.db", "ENSEMBL")
p1 <- cnetplot(edox, foldChange=sigLFC_uGFvCV, showCategory = 30,node_label="category")
p2 <- cnetplot(edox, categorySize="pvalue", foldChange=sigLFC_uGFvCV, showCategory = 30,node_label="gene")

ggsave2("GSEA_sigG_go_uGFvCV_cat_netw_20k_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = p1,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)

ggsave2("GSEA_sigG_go_uGFvCV_gene_netw_20k_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = p2,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)


##GO GSEA stats df
ensembl_gene_id_list <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id=go_uGFvCV_gsea@result[["geneID"]])

df_results_goterms_uGFvCV <- as.data.frame(go_uGFvCV_gsea@result)

dim(df_results_goterms_uGFvCV)

df_results_goterms_uGFvCV <- dplyr::filter(df_results_goterms_uGFvCV, p.adjust<=0.1)

dim(df_results_goterms_uGFvCV)

write_xlsx(df_results_goterms_uGFvCV, "GSEA_sigG_goterms_uGFvCV_20k.xlsx")

##GO terms with enriched genes in ensembl_gene_id
ensembl_gene_id_list_uGFvCV <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id=df_results_goterms_uGFvCV$core_enrichment)
  
mylist <-list()

for( i in row(ensembl_gene_id_list_uGFvCV)){
  mylist_temp <- list(str_split(ensembl_gene_id_list_uGFvCV[i, "ensembl_gene_id"], 
                 pattern = "/",simplify = T))
  mylist[[length(mylist) + 1]] <- mylist_temp
}

GOterm_sig_uGFvCV_df <-  lapply(mylist, unlist)

GOterm_sig_uGFvCV_df <- plyr::ldply(GOterm_sig_uGFvCV_df, rbind)

rownames(GOterm_sig_uGFvCV_df) <- df_results_goterms_uGFvCV$ID

GOterm_sig_uGFvCV_df$GOdescription <- df_results_goterms_uGFvCV$Description

        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r}
namesV <- sigLFC_uFvM$entrezgene_id
sigLFC_uFvM <- sigLFC_uFvM$log2FoldChange# named numeric vector
```

```{r}
namesV <- sigLFC_uFvM$ensembl_gene_id
sigLFC_uFvM <- sigLFC_uFvM$log2FoldChange# named numeric vector
names(sigLFC_uFvM) <- namesV

##GO gene set enrichment analisis (GSEA) using sigLFC_uFvM named vector
sigLFC_uFvM <- sort(sigLFC_uFvM, decreasing = T)

go_uFvM_gsea <- gseGO(geneList     = sigLFC_uFvM,
                       OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,

                     pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
                     verbose      = FALSE, 
                     keyType      = 'ENSEMBL',

dim(go_uFvM_gsea)

dim(go_uFvM_gsea)


length(sigLFC_uFvM) # gene universe

#GO gene set enrichment analisis Sig genes netwok plot
library("ggnewscale")
edox <- setReadable(go_uFvM_gsea, "org.Mm.eg.db", "ENSEMBL")
p1 <- cnetplot(edox, foldChange=sigLFC_uFvM, showCategory = 30,node_label="category")
p2 <- cnetplot(edox, categorySize="pvalue", foldChange=sigLFC_uFvM, showCategory = 30,node_label="gene")

ggsave2("GSEA_sigG_go_uFvM_cat_netw_20k_jun2022.pdf",

ggsave2("GSEA_sigG_go_uFvM_gene_netw_20k_jun2022.pdf",

dim(df_results_goterms_uFvM)

dim(df_results_goterms_uFvM)

##GO terms with enriched genes in ensembl_gene_id

  mylist_temp <- list(str_split(ensembl_gene_id_list_uFvM[i, "ensembl_gene_id"], 
                 pattern = "/",simplify = T))
  mylist[[length(mylist) + 1]] <- mylist_temp
}
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
class(kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu)

kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu$padj <- as.numeric(kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu$padj)

ensembl_id_gen_maleGFvCVu <- kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu$ensembl_gene_id

table(ensembl_id_gen_maleGFvCVu==kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu$ensembl_gene_id)

                                       "entrezgene_id",

                     filters = c("ensembl_gene_id"),

                     mart = mouse)
```

```{r}
kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu <- dplyr::arrange(kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu,desc(abs(kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu$log2FoldChange)))
dim(kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu)

#no filter, all genes in

names(allLFC_maleGFvCVu) <- kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu$entrezgene_id # named numeric vector


#pathview
LFC_maleGFvCVu <- kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu$log2FoldChange
names(LFC_maleGFvCVu) <- kgg_gfcv_maleGFvCVu$entrezgene_id
pathview(gene.data = LFC_maleGFvCVu, 
         pathway.id = "mmu00270", 
         species = "mmu", 
         limit = list(gene=2, cpd=1))

##KEGG overrepresentation test using allGenes_maleGFvCVu gene names only

}
```

```{r}
#filter padj < 0.1 and LFC > 0.1
```

```{r}
                 pattern = "/",simplify = T))
  mylist[[length(mylist) + 1]] <- mylist_temp
}

GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df <-  lapply(mylist, unlist)

GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df <- plyr::ldply(GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df, rbind)

rownames(GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df) <- df_results_goterms_maleGFvCV$ID

GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df$GOdescription <- df_results_goterms_maleGFvCV$Description

GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df <- GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df%>% relocate(GOdescription, .before = "1")

GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df$GOp.adj <- df_results_goterms_maleGFvCV$p.adjust

GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df <- GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df%>% relocate(GOp.adj, .before = "1")

GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df$GOterm_ID <- df_results_goterms_maleGFvCV$ID

GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df <- GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df%>% relocate(GOterm_ID, 
                                                       .before = "GOdescription")

GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df <- as.data.frame(t(GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df))

# View(GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df)

write_xlsx(GOterm_all_maleGFvCV_df, "GSEA_allG_by_goterms_maleGFvCV_20k.xlsx")

#treeplot

edox2 <- pairwise_termsim(edox)

tree <- treeplot(edox2, hclust_method = "average", nCluster = 10)

ggsave2("GSEA_allG_go_maleGFvCV_tree_20k_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = tree,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)


#upsetplot
upset <- sort(allLFC_maleGFvCV, decreasing = T) #upset <- testFC[order(abs(testFC),decreasing = T)]

go2 <- gseGO(geneList     = upset,
                     OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                     ont          = "ALL",
                     minGSSize    = 10,
                     maxGSSize    = 500,
                     pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
                     verbose      = FALSE, 
                     keyType      = 'ENSEMBL',
                     nPermSimple = 10000)


up <- upsetplot(go2)


ggsave2("GSEA_allG_go_maleGFvCV_upset_20k_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = up,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)

#heatplot

heat <- heatplot(edox, foldChange=testFC)

ggsave2("GSEA_Allgens_go_maleGFvCV_heat_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = heat,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)
```

####female GFvCV, 20k kegg and GO overrepresented test and GSEA
######SigG_ORA_KEGG
```{r}
setwd ("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/RNAseq/comp_female_GFvsCV_wald_20k/femaleGFvCV_SigG_ORA_KEGG_20k/")
####KEGG analysis####
###input df A x ORA: DE Sig genes (padj, LFC, ID) from results(DESeq2) padj<0.1
kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id=resddsGFCV80w20k_GFFvCVF_all_df$ensembl_gene_id)

kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV$padj <- resddsGFCV80w20k_GFFvCVF_all_df$padj

kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV$log2FoldChange <- resddsGFCV80w20k_GFFvCVF_all_df$log2FoldChange

class(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV)

kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV$padj <- as.numeric(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV$padj)

kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV$log2FoldChange <- as.numeric(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV$log2FoldChange)


ensembl_id_gen_femaleGFvCV <- kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV$ensembl_gene_id

table(ensembl_id_gen_femaleGFvCV==kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV$ensembl_gene_id)

#add description and entrezgene_id and entrezgene_accession
femaleGFvCV_kg_bioMart <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id",
                                       "entrezgene_id",
                                       "entrezgene_accession"),
                     filters = c("ensembl_gene_id"),
                     values= c(ensembl_id_gen_femaleGFvCV),
                     mart = mouse)
dim(femaleGFvCV_kg_bioMart)
length(ensembl_id_gen_femaleGFvCV)
colnames(femaleGFvCV_kg_bioMart)
colnames(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV)

kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV <- dplyr::inner_join(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV, femaleGFvCV_kg_bioMart, by = "ensembl_gene_id")
kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV <- dplyr::arrange(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV,desc(abs(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV$log2FoldChange)))
dim(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV)

#filter padj < 0.1 and LFC > 0.1
sigGenes_femaleGFvCV <- kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV %>% #vector of gene names
                drop_na(entrezgene_id, padj) %>% 
                filter(padj < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.1) %>% 
                pull(entrezgene_id)
sigLFC_femaleGFvCV <- kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV %>%filter(padj < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.1) 
sigLFC_femaleGFvCV <- sigLFC_femaleGFvCV %>%drop_na(entrezgene_id) # named numeric vector


#pathview
LFC_femaleGFvCV <- sigLFC_femaleGFvCV$log2FoldChange
names(LFC_femaleGFvCV) <- sigLFC_femaleGFvCV$entrezgene_id
pathview(gene.data = LFC_femaleGFvCV, 
         pathway.id = "mmu00270", 
         species = "mmu", 
         limit = list(gene=2, cpd=1))


##KEGG overrepresentation test using sigGenes_femaleGFvCV gene names only
kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV <- enrichKEGG(gene = sigGenes_femaleGFvCV, organism = "mmu")
# View(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV)
kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV <- dplyr::filter(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV, p.adjust<=0.1)
dim(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV)

kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV <- dplyr::arrange(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV, p.adjust)


dim(sigLFC_femaleGFvCV)
testFC <- sigLFC_femaleGFvCV$log2FoldChange
names(testFC) <- sigLFC_femaleGFvCV$entrezgene_id # gene universe

#KEGG overrepresented Sig genes netwok plot
library("ggnewscale")
edox <- setReadable(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV, "org.Mm.eg.db", "ENTREZID")
p1 <- cnetplot(edox, foldChange=testFC, showCategory = 30,node_label="category")
p2 <- cnetplot(edox, categorySize="pvalue", foldChange=testFC, showCategory = 30,node_label="gene")
p3 <- cnetplot(edox, categorySize="pvalue", foldChange=testFC, showCategory = 100,node_label="category")

ggsave2("ORA_sigG_kk_femaleGFvCV_cat_netw_20k_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = p1,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)

ggsave2("ORA_sigG_kk_femaleGFvCV_gene_netw_20k_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = p2,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)

ggsave2("ORA_sigG_kk_femaleGFvCV_netw_20k_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = p3,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 30,
        height = 30,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)

##KEGG overrepresented stats df
entrezgene_id_list <- data.frame(entrezgene_id=kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV@result[["geneID"]])

df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV <- as.data.frame(kgg_gfcv_femaleGFvCV@result)

dim(df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV)

df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV <- dplyr::filter(df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV, p.adjust<=0.1)

dim(df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV)

write_xlsx(df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV, "ORA_sigG_kkterms_femaleGFvCV_20k.xlsx")

##KEGG termS overrepresented genes in entrezgene_id
entrezgene_id_list_femaleGFvCV <- data.frame(entrezgene_id=df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV$geneID)
  
mylist <-list()

for( i in row(entrezgene_id_list_femaleGFvCV)){
  mylist_temp <- list(str_split(entrezgene_id_list_femaleGFvCV[i, "entrezgene_id"], 
                 pattern = "/",simplify = T))
  mylist[[length(mylist) + 1]] <- mylist_temp
}

GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df <-  lapply(mylist, unlist)

GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df <- plyr::ldply(GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df, rbind)

rownames(GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df) <- df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV$ID

GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df$GOdescription <- df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV$Description

GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df <- GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df%>% relocate(GOdescription, .before = "1")

GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df$GOp.adj <- df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV$p.adjust

GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df <- GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df%>% relocate(GOp.adj, .before = "1")

GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df$GOterm_ID <- df_results_kkterms_femaleGFvCV$ID

GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df <- GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df%>% relocate(GOterm_ID, 
                                                       .before = "GOdescription")

GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df <- as.data.frame(t(GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df))

write_xlsx(GOterm_sig_femaleGFvCV_df, "ORA_sigG_by_kkterms_femaleGFvCV_20k.xlsx")

#treeplot

edox2 <- pairwise_termsim(edox)

tree <- treeplot(edox2, hclust_method = "average", nCluster = 10)

ggsave2("ORA_sigG_kk_femaleGFvCV_tree_20k_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = tree,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)

#upsetplot
upset <- names(testFC) #upset <- testFC[order(abs(testFC),decreasing = T)]

kk2 <- enrichKEGG(gene      = upset,
               organism     = 'mmu',
               minGSSize    = 10,
               pvalueCutoff = 0.1)


up <- upsetplot(kk2)


ggsave2("ORA_sigG_kk_femaleGFvCV_upset_20k_jun2022.pdf",
        plot = up,
        device = NULL,path = NULL,
        scale = 1,width = 10,
        height = 10,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r}
go_gfcv_convFvM <- dplyr::arrange(go_gfcv_convFvM,desc(abs(go_gfcv_convFvM$log2FoldChange)))
dim(go_gfcv_convFvM)
```

```{r}
#no filter, all genes in

#pathview
```

```{r}
##GO GSEA using allGenes_convFvM gene names only

go_convFvM_gsea <- gseGO(geneList     = allLFC_convFvM,
                     OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                     ont          = "ALL",
                     minGSSize    = 10,
                     maxGSSize    = 500,
                     pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
                     verbose      = FALSE, 
                     keyType      = 'ENSEMBL',
                     nPermSimple = 10000)

# View(go_convFvM_gsea)
dim(go_convFvM_gsea)
go_convFvM_gsea <- dplyr::filter(go_convFvM_gsea, p.adjust<=0.1)
go_convFvM_gsea <- dplyr::arrange(go_convFvM_gsea, p.adjust)
dim(go_convFvM_gsea)


length(allLFC_convFvM)

#GO GSEA All genes netwok plot

p1 <- cnetplot(edox, foldChange=allLFC_convFvM, showCategory = 30,node_label="category")
p2 <- cnetplot(edox, categorySize="pvalue", foldChange=allLFC_convFvM, showCategory = 30,node_label="gene")
p3 <- cnetplot(edox, categorySize="pvalue", foldChange=allLFC_convFvM, showCategory = 100,node_label="category")

options(ggrepel.max.overlaps = Inf)

ggsave2("GSEA_allG_go_convFvM_cat_netw_20k_jun2022.pdf",

ggsave2("GSEA_allG_go_convFvM_netw_20k_jun2022.pdf",

        height = 30,units = "in",
        dpi = 300,limitsize = FALSE)

##GO GSEA stats df

dim(df_results_goterms_convFvM)

dim(df_results_goterms_convFvM)

##GO enriched terms with  genes in ensembl_gene_id

}
```

```{r}
go_gfcv_convFvMu$log2FoldChange <- as.numeric(go_gfcv_convFvMu$log2FoldChange)


ensembl_id_gen_convFvMu <- go_gfcv_convFvMu$ensembl_gene_id

table(ensembl_id_gen_convFvMu==go_gfcv_convFvMu$ensembl_gene_id)

#add description and entrezgene_id and entrezgene_accession
convFvMu_go_bioMart <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id",
                                       "entrezgene_id",
```

```{r}
go_gfcv_convFvMu <- dplyr::arrange(go_gfcv_convFvMu,desc(abs(go_gfcv_convFvMu$log2FoldChange)))
dim(go_gfcv_convFvMu)

#filter padj < 0.1 and LFC > 0.1
sigLFC_convFvMu <- go_gfcv_convFvMu %>%filter(padj < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.1) 
sigLFC_convFvMu <- go_gfcv_convFvMu %>%drop_na(entrezgene_id) 
namesV <- sigLFC_convFvMu$entrezgene_id
sigLFC_convFvMu <- sigLFC_convFvMu$log2FoldChange# named numeric vector

#pathview
pathview(gene.data = sigLFC_convFvMu, 
         pathway.id = "mmu00270", 
         species = "mmu", 
         limit = list(gene=2, cpd=1))

#filter padj < 0.1 and LFC > 0.1

sigLFC_convFvMu <- sigLFC_convFvMu$log2FoldChange# named numeric vector

                       OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                     ont          = "ALL",
                     minGSSize    = 10,
                     maxGSSize    = 500,
                     pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
                     verbose      = FALSE,

                     nPermSimple = 10000)
```

#clusterlCompare
The compareCluster() function applies selected function (via the fun parameter) to perform enrichment analysis for each gene list.
```{r}
clusterCompare_list <- list(sigDEg_int=sigLFC_int,
                            sigDEg_GFvCV=sigLFC_GFvCV,
                            sigDEg_FvM=sigLF_FvM,
                            sigDEg_GFMvCVM=sigLFC_maleGFvCV,
                            sigDEg_GFFvCVF=sigLFC_femaleGFvCV,
                            sigDEg_GFFvGFM=sigLFC_germfreeFvM,
                            sigDEg_CVFvCVM=sigLFC_convFvM)

ck <- compareCluster(geneCluster = clusterCompare_list, 
                     fun = enrichKEGG)
ck <- setReadable(ck, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType="ENSEMBL")
head(ck) 

dotplot(ck)
```
